title: Hurricane Maria
description:
Interview stringer of Puerto Rico State Guard Air Force Capt. Edgardo Barreto and Puerto Rico State Guard Army SSG. Hiram Gonzales discussing their roles in Hurricane Maria relief efforts at the Emergency Operations Center located in the Puerto Rico Convention Center, San Juan.
Hurricane Maria formed in the Atlantic Ocean and affected islands in the Caribbean Sea, including Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands. U.S. Military assets supported FEMA as well as state and local authorities in rescue and relief efforts. (U.S. Air Force video by Senior Airman Tayor Harrison)
keywords: Puerto Rico State Guard, Hurricane Maria, EOC Convention Center, Puerto Rico
